o1: Predicted to enable protein tyrosine kinase activity and receptor tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; left/right axis specification; asymmetric cell division; and mitotic spindle orientation. Is located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in E; Psub2; Psub3; Psub4; and germ line. Is part of the MES-1/SRC-1 signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with SRC-1.
